embedded_ivos.text: Each company’s Memorandum of Understanding establishes the framework for the U.S. AI Safety Institute to receive access to major new models from each company prior to and following their public release. The agreements will enable collaborative research on how to evaluate capabilities and safety risks, as well as methods to mitigate those risks.
embedded_ivos.context: NIST release on agreements with Anthropic and OpenAI. This historical statement describes external model access, not embedded auditors.

attribution.speaker: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
